description: Redesign the landing page component (LandingPage.tsx) and its CSS (landing.css, landing-pro.css) to fix all visual bugs, improve typography/spacing, implement the new design system colors, and create a cohesive premium look. This includes: fixing text errors, redesigning the ministry strip to be lighter, updating the header/navbar, fixing hero section spacing, redesigning stats/features/AI/roles/results/testimonials/CTA/footer sections, and ensuring consistent icon colors (no random inline styles).
steps: Step 1 - Fix text errors in LandingPage.tsx: (a) The hero title reads 'منصة الزاوية:\nجامعة الزاوية للتعليم الذكي' - add a space after the colon so it reads 'منصة الزاوية: ' not 'منصة الزاوية:'. (b) The CTA buttons 'ابدأ رحلتك الآن' and 'اكتشف المنصة' are in separate Link/a elements with proper gap in .landing-cta-row - verify they are visually separated (the user said they appear merged - check CSS gap is sufficient). (c) The brand text shows 'الزاوية' + 'جامعة الزاوية' as separate spans - add a middle dot separator or ensure visual spacing.

Step 2 - Redesign the ministry strip: Replace the heavy dark navy gradient (linear-gradient(90deg, #0E2148...)) in .ministry-strip with a lighter, more elegant style. Use a subtle background that works in both themes: light theme uses a soft blue-gray tint, dark theme uses a slightly elevated surface. Remove the hardcoded #FFFFFF color and #FFD166 strong color - use token-based colors instead.

Step 3 - Remove ALL inline style={{}} color/background declarations from LandingPage.tsx. The KPI strip icons have hardcoded backgrounds like style={{ background: 'rgba(41, 82, 200, 0.10)', color: '#1e40af' }}. Replace with data-tone attributes or CSS classes (data-tone='primary', data-tone='success', data-tone='tertiary', data-tone='secondary') and define the icon colors in landing.css using the new token palette.

Step 4 - Similarly remove inline styles from the role pillar section (.landing-feature-icon). Each card has style={{ background: '...', color: '...' }}. Replace with data-tone attributes and CSS-driven styles.

Step 5 - Rewrite landing.css: (a) Update .landing-hero to use new spacing tokens, fix line-height on .landing-title for Arabic text (min 1.3), add proper gap between title elements. (b) Update .landing-cta-row to ensure buttons have clear visual separation (min gap: 16px). (c) Update .landing-bento (features grid) to use new tokens. (d) Update .landing-features-grid (roles) from 3-col to 4-col on desktop (there are 4 role cards). (e) Update .landing-pilot (results) stats styles. (f) Update testimonial card styles. (g) Update footer to be cleaner.

Step 6 - Consolidate landing-pro.css: Move all legitimate overrides from landing-pro.css into landing.css (the hero eyebrow, sticky header glass, title gradient text, hero image frame). Then reduce landing-pro.css to minimal premium additions only (no conflicting redefinitions). Remove the !important declarations where possible.

Step 7 - Update .kpi-strip and .kpi-cell styles to use consistent token-based icon backgrounds via [data-tone] selectors: [data-tone='primary'] gets --color-primary with soft bg, [data-tone='success'] gets a green variant, [data-tone='tertiary'] gets teal, [data-tone='secondary'] gets gold. These should work in both light and dark themes.

Step 8 - Fix .landing-features-grid: Change from 3 columns to 2x2 grid (repeat(2, 1fr)) on desktop since there are 4 role cards, or use repeat(4, 1fr) for a horizontal row. Ensure responsive: 2-col on tablet, 1-col on mobile.
Step 9 - Add a ThemeToggle button to the landing header. Import ThemeToggle in LandingPage.tsx and place it in the header next to the login button. Style it for the landing page context.
Step 10 - Update the CTA section (.landing-final-cta) to use the new primary blue palette instead of hardcoded #001c38/#003461/#004b87 gradients. Use CSS custom properties so it adapts to theme.
acceptance_criteria: No inline style={{}} with hardcoded colors remain in LandingPage.tsx
All text spacing issues are fixed (space after colon in title, buttons visually separated)
Ministry strip uses token-based colors, not hardcoded hex values
KPI icons use data-tone attributes with CSS-driven colors
Role cards display in a proper 4-card grid layout
ThemeToggle is present in the landing header
landing-pro.css has no !important declarations or conflicting rules
All color values in landing.css reference CSS custom properties, not hardcoded hex (except within custom property definitions)
verification: Run: grep for style={{ in LandingPage.tsx - should find zero or near-zero results
Run: grep for hardcoded hex colors (#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}) in landing.css body (outside of :root/theme definitions) - should be zero
Validate CSS brace balance in landing.css and landing-pro.css
Verify .landing-features-grid uses proper column count for 4 cards
